Subject: Backfill strategy, priming window and rerank audit — Novato Health onboarding

Lucy / team —

Thanks for the kickoff call this morning. Attached is a concise plan for the indexing backfill and the priming window we discussed. High-level constraints we captured:

- Minimal read-impact for your production search (target < 2% P95 latency delta)
- A 48-hour priming window where we replay high-value queries to prefill the KV cache and seed reranker training samples
- Preservation of your existing relevance baseline for at least two weeks after cutover; we will run blind A/B rerank evaluations before flip.

Can you confirm the maintenance window Novato prefers (overnight PST or weekend)? Also confirm whether VectorDB will accept concurrent writes during their compacting cycle (matrixdb-team said they have a weekly compact at 03:00 UTC).

Next steps from our side: we will produce a backfill script that supports resumption, a sampling job for rerank evals, and a runbook with rollback criteria. See attachments: backfill_plan_v1.pdf and priming_samples.csv.

Proposed meeting: Thurs 2026-07-08 10:00 AM PT for finalize runbook and risks.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Appreciate the summary and attachments. Quick answers:

- Maintenance window: Prefer weekend low-traffic window, Sat 02:00–06:00 PT if that is workable.
- VectorDB compaction: They do weekly compaction, but we can request a deferral. I'll loop our infra ops if needed.

Two asks from our side before the Thurs call:
1) Can you provide approximate wall-clock time and IO profile for a 5M doc backfill (we run ~200 ops/sec during business hours and want to avoid spikes)?
2) Rerank evals: we need the exact sample schema to validate PII trimming — don’t include raw PHI. The sample csv looked like full query text; can you provide a redacted schema?

I'll bring in Procurement on Thursday if there are any DocuSign/contract items tied to the risk acceptance or SLA changes.

—Lucy

Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 08:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Backfill strategy, priming window and rerank audit — Novato Health onboarding

Lucy —

Quick technical notes ahead of the call (short bullets):

- Backfill throughput estimate: on our Dedicated medium pool (A100 x4 equivalence) we expect ~120k vectors/hour with the proposed batched writer. For 5M docs that's ~42 hours wall time; if you accept burst capacity we can reduce to ~18–20 hours. IO profile: sustained write rate ~450–600 MB/s, peaking briefly on compaction.
- Resumable backfill: checkpoint every 100k docs, with idempotent writes. Script includes an option to throttle by QPS or tokens/sec.
- Priming window: we recommend a 48-hour synthetic priming that replays top 10% of queries + 5% random sample to warm both KV cache and reranker embeddings.
- Rerank eval artifacts: attached is rerank_eval_matrix.xlsx with column definitions. For PII: we will accept a redacted query column and a context_id pointer instead of raw text; reranker inputs can be hashed or pseudonymized.

I'll bring a rough ops schedule to the call and confirm compaction interplay with VectorDB.

-Karthik

Lucy / Marissa team —

Couple practical items from CS/ops to align on Friday:

1) Acceptance criteria for the rerank flip (suggested):
   - Blind A/B on 1% live traffic for 72 hours with no >1% drop in conversion on primary KPI
   - No regression in precision@10 beyond 3% on our eval set
2) Rollback triggers: sustained P95 latency increase >250ms for 10 minutes OR error rate >0.5% for 15 minutes.
3) Communications plan: status channel in Slack + hourly email digests during the backfill window.

Calendar invite: Sat 2026-07-11 02:00–06:00 PT (proposed) — if that conflicts, propose alternate weekend slot.

Also: I created a temporary cluster URL for a smoke run: https://staging.redwood.ai/novato/smoke-3 — credentials will be sent to your infra ops.

-jordan
